name: A-B Loop
author: Noctis
description: Loop a part of a song to practise or learn it: set A and B, nudge them into place, repeat a set number of times and save named loops for each song.

settings.label: Gap before each repeat
settings.description: A short pause at B before the part starts again. The window can change it too.

settings.label: Keep loops for each song
settings.description: Saved loops stay with the song for next time. Off: they last until Noctis closes.

settings.label: Nudge step
settings.description: How far the arrows move A or B. Hold Shift for the other step.
